description.p: Chat with any model, let it read and edit your project, run commands, browse the web, and review every change, in one native app.

ul.li: Chats keep running in the background while you switch chat or project
Every edit as a line-numbered diff you can review and rewind
A Git panel with stashes, sync, branches and per-project accounts
A built-in terminal and a browser the agent can use
MCP servers and skills from Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Codex
